factual_fidelity.evidence: '200 m² Fläch mat 4 Schlofzëmmeren' matches inputs; no contradictions but 'Eegen Terrasse mat Ausbléck op de Gaart' is consistent with terrace=true.

completeness.evidence: Mentions 200 m², 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, garden, garage, terrace, storage, but omits price (3400) and bathrooms only mentioned in description, not Differdange neighborhood name.

native_quality.evidence: Awkward phrasing like 'dobbelten Drockgarage', 'Dëbblet Garage fir Paken', 'Gréisser Gaart mat Patiosaach' read as machine-translated.

market_fit.evidence: 'Drockgarage', 'Patiosaach', 'Rasemanner' are not standard Luxembourgish real-estate vocabulary.

compliance_cpe.evidence: 'Energiepass: Klass gëtt nogeräicht.' surfaces a placeholder rather than inventing a class.

seo_signal.evidence: Title 'Gedéngte 4-Schlofzëmmer Villa mat Gaart a Double-Garage an etabléierter Géigend' is appropriate length; 5 CamelCase hashtags 'VintageVilla EtabléiertStil PrivateGaart DëbbletGarage Steenchemin'.

tone_discipline.evidence: No exclamation marks or hyperbolic words like 'breathtaking'; phrases such as 'charméiert' are restrained.

fair_housing.evidence: No references to occupant demographics; 'Déi etabléiert Plaz bitt eng roueg Ëmfeld' is neutral.

hallucination.evidence: All facts (200 m², stone fireplace, double garage, mature trees, patio) are grounded in inputs/photo analyses.

cross_lang_consistency.evidence: All four languages (LU, DE, EN, FR) agree on 200 m², 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, double garage, fireplace, terrace; FR adds 'clôturé' and DE adds 'Außenstellplätze' as minor extras.

notes: Luxembourgish vocabulary feels invented in places.
